The call site inside wrap() is untouched; the same local name is now bound to the shared splitter. THE ASSERTION. assert.equal(splitToken.hardSplits, 0, ...) runs after every composed document is laid out, so a future route key with no separator to break on FAILS THE BUILD instead of shipping chopped. AFTER: '...notation-of-clearance-after-a-wrongful-' / 'arrest-under-13-4051' -- the separator ends the line and announces the token as continuing, which is the shape this lane already passed for Washington. Nothing else on either page moved.
